course.title: Full Stack Web Development
course.subtitle: An introduction to building complete web applications, front to back

lessons.title: Welcome & How This Course Works
lessons.summary: Meet the course, see the roadmap, and set up your toolbox.

lessons.title: Foundations: Version Control & GitHub
lessons.summary: Why developers track every change, and how Git and GitHub make collaboration possible.

lessons.title: Cloud Computing: Renting the Internet's Infrastructure
lessons.summary: What "the cloud" actually is, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, and the tradeoffs of renting infrastructure instead of owning it.

lessons.title: Systems Design: MVC, Components & Agile Thinking
lessons.summary: How applications are structured, and how teams decide what to build next.

lessons.title: Requirements, Wireframes & Your First JavaScript
lessons.summary: Turning a vague idea into a plan, then turning that plan into code.

lessons.title: The Developer Toolkit: Markdown & npm
lessons.summary: The everyday tools that keep a project organized and shareable.

lessons.title: APIs & JSON: How Applications Talk to Each Other
lessons.summary: The data format and request pattern behind almost every modern app.

lessons.title: Careers in Web Development, Agile & DevOps
lessons.summary: What the job actually looks like, and how teams ship software together.

lessons.title: The Server Side: Node.js & Express
lessons.summary: Writing JavaScript that runs on a server instead of a browser.

lessons.title: Databases: SQL, NoSQL & Managed Services
lessons.summary: How applications store, query, and relate data — and when to use which kind of database.

lessons.title: Security: Auth, HTTPS & Common Vulnerabilities

lessons.title: Frontend Frameworks: Bootstrap, Alpine & Beyond
lessons.summary: Why frameworks exist, and how to choose one for a given job.

lessons.title: Developer Resources, Testing & Debugging
lessons.summary: The reference sites, tools, and habits that make you self-sufficient.

lessons.title: Capstone Review: Architecture & Your Next Steps
lessons.summary: Tying the whole stack together and planning where to go from here.
